needs_adapter.name: جدارات - القطاع العام وشبه الحكومي والتعاقدي
needs_adapter.why: Biggest gap. The jadarat collector reads only ExploreJobs (= JobTab=1, القطاع الخاص), and all 1292 Jadarat jobs in the store are 'القطاع الخاص'. Civil-service, semi-government and contract jobs sit on separate tabs that we never open, so no government entity is covered via Jadarat today.
needs_adapter.method: Render with Playwright exactly as jadarat.collect does. LINK_SEL, CARDS_JS and parse_card all work on these tabs (tested). The only change is a JobTab parameter, or a loop over the tabs with a few pages each. The page gets its data from the internal screenservices/UEP_CW/PublicJobs_CW/PublicList/DataActionGetData; do NOT call that directly. Read the rendered page.
needs_adapter.empty_state: 'نأسف، لا توجد أي وظائف متاحة في الوقت الحالي' with a '0 وظيفة' header. Tabs 2 and 4 are empty today: civil-service jobs open in announcement windows.

needs_adapter.name: SuccessFactors CSB tile layout (sf_csb extension)
needs_adapter.why: ZATCA (and likely other CSB tenants) renders li.job-tile[data-url] with a.jobTitle-link instead of tr.data-row, so sf_csb returns 0 for it. The html entry above covers ZATCA. A small sf_csb fallback would cover every tile-layout tenant: read li.job-tile when no tr.data-row is found, with a page size of data-per-page.
